# Reply: check_project.py passed a project the Construct 3 editor refused

## Result

- The checker did not catch the problem. `check_project.py` passes the project with `+` in the two label expressions (`"goblin " + Goblin.IID`, `"orc " + Orc.IID`). I reproduced this on a copy and the checker still ends with `ok:`.
- The editor refuses that copy with the same message you saw: `Game, event 13, action 1 and action 2: Type mismatch: + does not work with 'string' and 'number'`.
- Your project as it is now (with `&`) opens in the editor (`opened ... (Coins - Construct 3)`). I did not change any file in the project folder. The only files I wrote are the copy under `outputs/repro-plus/` and the script's own output in its `.tmp/`.

## Why the checker missed it

- The checker has no type check for `+` or `&`. Its only type rule (`checker-rules.md`, the row about a local named like a global of another type) covers one shadowing case with `-`. The file `checker-rules.md` (section "What it does not see", around line 428) says the editor checks expression types when it opens a project, so the gap is known to the maintainers, but `SKILL.md` describes the checker as checking "the rules the Construct 3 editor applies when it opens a project", which overstates what it does.
- `checker_expressions.py` only rewrites C-style operators (`==`, `!=`, `&&`, `||`) to Construct ones. A `+` between a text literal and a number passes.

## Report for the skill's maintainers

Title: Editor refused a project the checker passed: `+` between text and a number

Body:

The checker (`scripts/check_project.py`) passes a project whose event sheet uses `+` to join a text literal and a number. The Construct 3 editor refuses the project when it opens it.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Project saved with r495.2, with an event sheet `Game`, event 13: `System: On start of layout`, with two actions `Set label to "goblin " + Goblin.IID` and `Set label to "orc " + Orc.IID` (the expression is stored as a string value, `"\"goblin \" + Goblin.IID"`).
2. Run `python .agents/skills/construct3-agent-plugin/scripts/check_project.py`.

Expected: the checker reports the problem, or the editor opens the project.

Actual: the checker ends with `ok: 11 object types, 0 families, 2 layouts, 1 sheets, ...` and exits 0. The editor refuses the project:

```
Invalid expressions In some circumstances, previous versions of Construct allow invalid expressions to be used. ... Game, event 13, action 1: Type mismatch: + does not work with 'string' and 'number' Game, event 13, action 2: Type mismatch: + does not work with 'string' and 'number'
```

With `&` in place of `+`, the same project opens.

Suggested fix: add a check of the operands of `+` (and `-`, `*`, `/`) when one side is a text literal or a string-typed value, and write the rule as a message that names `&` for concatenation. Test it against the official example projects first, as `checker-rules.md` describes for a new rule.

Editor report generated by the script (`open_in_editor.py`), fingerprint 9481904ae9d5, editor r506.3, Construct3-RAG 86a8a7f:

```
Invalid expressions ... <sheet 1>, event 13, action 1: Type mismatch: + does not work with 'string' and 'number' <sheet 1>, event 13, action 2: Type mismatch: + does not work with 'string' and 'number'
  13 System: On start of layout
         -> <object 10>: Set <variable 3> to "…" + <object 10>.IID
         -> <object 11>: Set <variable 3> to "…" + <object 11>.IID
```

The full generated report is at `<run>\outputs\repro-plus\.tmp\editor-report-9481904ae9d5.md`. Its names are placeholders. It is not sent anywhere. To file it under your GitHub account, run `gh issue create --repo XHXIAIEIN/Construct3-Agent-Skills --title "Editor refused a project the checker passed (9481904ae9d5)" --body-file "<that path>"`, or paste the file into https://github.com/XHXIAIEIN/Construct3-Agent-Skills/issues/new.

## Commands run

All run from PowerShell. Project folder: `<run>\project`.

1. `cd <project>; python .agents/skills/construct3-agent-plugin/scripts/check_project.py` - ok, exit 0. `.git` does not exist in the project (`Test-Path .git` = False).
2. `cd <project>; python .agents/skills/construct3-agent-plugin/scripts/print_sheet.py Game --events 12-14` - shows event 13 with `&`, so the project already has the fix.
3. Read `SKILL.md`, `checker-rules.md` (lines 420-450), `checker_expressions.py` (lines 1-120), and grep of the scripts for `Type mismatch`, `+`, `&`, `string`.
4. `New-Item` of `outputs/`; `Copy-Item` of the project to `outputs/repro-plus`; replaced `"goblin " & Goblin.IID` and `"orc " & Orc.IID` with `+` in `outputs/repro-plus/eventSheets/Game.json` (`[IO.File]::ReadAllText` / `WriteAllText`); `Select-String IID` to confirm.
5. `python <project>/.agents/skills/construct3-agent-plugin/scripts/check_project.py --project <outputs>/repro-plus` - ok, exit 0 (the checker passes the `+` version).
6. `python .../open_in_editor.py --help` - usage.
7. `python .../open_in_editor.py --project <outputs>/repro-plus` - failed with the Type mismatch message, exit 1; wrote `.tmp/editor-report-9481904ae9d5.md` in the copy.
8. `python .../open_in_editor.py --project <project>` - opened, exit 0.

One attempt to delete the copy with `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force` on a variable path was blocked by a PreToolUse hook (`rm_target_guard.py`, Git Bash not found). I did not delete anything; the copy was created fresh with `Copy-Item`, and the next command used literal paths.
